target_question: Does a UAE entity of a multinational group need to register for Top-up Tax?

card.head: Is your UAE entity in scope for Top-up Tax?
card.sub: A check for UAE entities of multinational groups.

figure.label: Multinational group revenue of EUR 750m or more in at least 2 of the 4 preceding financial years brings its UAE entities into scope.

cta.d: Preparation and review, alongside your tax agent

card.source: Source: Federal Tax Authority press release on its Top-up Tax scope and registration guide, 7 Oct 2026 (tax.gov.ae); checked 14 Nov 2026. General information only, not legal or tax advice. Valorin is an independent advisory firm, not affiliated with the FTA or MoF.

alt: Card: the Federal Tax Authority says Top-up Tax applies to UAE entities of multinational groups with revenue of EUR 750m or more in at least two of the four preceding financial years; check group revenue, which UAE entities are in the group, and which registration timeline applies with your tax agent.

captions.linkedin:
If your UAE company is part of a multinational group with revenue of EUR 750m or more in at least two of the four preceding financial years, it's in scope for Top-up Tax.

The Federal Tax Authority says Top-up Tax applies to UAE Constituent Entities of multinational groups with annual revenue of EUR 750m or more in the Ultimate Parent Entity's consolidated financial statements in at least two of the four preceding financial years (FTA, 7 Oct 2026; checked 14 Nov 2026).

What we'd look at this week:
• Group revenue for the last four years against EUR 750m
• Which UAE entities count as Constituent Entities
• Which registration timeline applies, confirmed with your registered tax agent

We prepare and check the figures, alongside your registered tax agent.
